review_scope: Side-by-side technical review of 23 installed views against main. The separate Harukiya room capture shows jukebox operation. The standard surface cameras do not cover the selector. Lily’s setting review is open.

images.observation: The pendant pool, table edges and colored spot below the table read alike in the two rooms.
Both captures show the round pool across the tile band. The curtain and dark seat keep their silhouettes.
The figure in the apron, chairs, blind slats and desk lamp retain their positions and lighting.
The chair in the foreground and shelf against the rear wall keep their outlines in the amber light.
The light pool crosses the plaster between the worktops. Both captures show the rough transition at the top of the wall.
The front gauge, rectangular service door and overhead pipe remain distinct against the dark wall.
The bookcase and single chair keep their outlines. The candidate table, chair and shelf faces are darker.
Wall tile courses meet at the same corner behind the cistern and vertical service pipe.
Both cameras face a very dark brick surface. The shot does not show the lift mechanism.
The open leaf and enclosure are darker on the candidate. The upper contacts and row of round controls remain visible.
A worn horizontal rail crosses the dark recess above the square floor tiles in both close views.
The red cat on the shelf and the small framed portrait at left remain visible against the dark green wall.
The underside of the red shelf, supports, picture frames and rear light strip line up across the pair.
The candidate mail doors and adjacent woodwork are darker. The individual slots, labels and projecting papers are still separable.
The ribs stay distinct below the window. The valve end, table legs and object on the table have darker shading in the candidate.
The guard rails, equipment cage and hanging lamp keep their alignment against the wall and doorway.
The rooftop tank, ring rail and legs have the same silhouette against the patterned sky.
The green-lit terminal, clock and wall chart stay in view. The case and adjacent floor are darker in the candidate.
The mounting brackets, cistern cover and grout lines stay continuous around the tiled corner.
The coiled red form remains distinct from the colored floor patch within the amber beam under the radiator.
The upright red strands overlap the radiator ribs in the same position under the round light.
The crumb tray and crumbs are visible in both views. The candidate toaster and mug are darker against the countertop.
The station stays centered on the wall. The candidate has warm light at the frame edges and a darker station face with a less distinct circular detail.
